lockedDecisions.operatingModel: Website Ventures lives inside the existing Gamenfy repo/app under Finance → Ventures. It is mentally a commercial money-machine, but it does not need a separate architecture or repository.
lockedDecisions.developmentWorkflow: Use branch → test → PR → only then main/production. Personal-only Gamenfy surfaces may use data-gamenfy-scope="personal".
lockedDecisions.businessGoal: Prove a repeatable website-sales business before optimizing for provinces, teams or mass scale. Customers 1–10 come before 100,000-customer architecture.
lockedDecisions.firstSalesHypothesis: Trades/plumbing/installation is the leading first niche because the digital gap may be larger and DIY-AI substitution lower; beauty/nails/coaches remain useful alternative markets because Joey expects an easier personal sales match.
lockedDecisions.flagshipStrategy: Build at least four knockout showcase websites across distinct categories rather than four copies of the same niche.
lockedDecisions.designAmbition: State-of-the-art, modern, striking and luxury/high-end. The site should feel expensive enough to give Joey confidence when selling; the aspiration is deliberately beyond normal local-MKB design.
lockedDecisions.referenceFeel: VOZOL-like effort/tech polish is a useful inspiration, but borrow the premium branded experience rather than the visual overload.
lockedDecisions.aiVisualRule: Heavy AI use is acceptable when the result remains realistic, polished and website-usable; roughly 90% realistic / 10% overt cinematic stylization is acceptable.
lockedDecisions.proofIntegrity: Real staff identity and completed customer projects should use real evidence when they are presented as such. AI may create atmosphere, demo worlds and illustrative service scenes, but should not fabricate proof.
lockedDecisions.plumbingPositioning: Use emergency/urgency as the opening hook, then position the company as a premium allround plumbing/installations brand rather than a pure 24/7 emergency service.
lockedDecisions.plumbingStory: Problem → urgency → contact → rapid arrival → inspection → skilled repair → clean handover → relief/trust → CTA.
lockedDecisions.plumbingTone: Subtle/chic and unmistakably high-end; no slapstick chaos or screaming-discount aesthetic.
lockedDecisions.plumbingPaletteCandidate: Primary candidate: pure white + deep signature red + stone/marble + chrome/glass/water. Candidate, not yet permanently locked.
lockedDecisions.operatorPrinciple: Porsche treatment, authentic tradesperson: the design shell can be extremely premium while the actual operator remains nuchter, diverse and recognizably themselves.
lockedDecisions.characterStrategy: For the first plumbing flagship, prioritize one exceptionally strong, consistent hero technician reusable across the entire site instead of many unrelated people.
lockedDecisions.assetRule: Website applicability and consistency beat raw generation volume. A beautiful asset that cannot be coherently deployed is low-value.
lockedDecisions.higgsfieldRule: Treat the subscription as a planned production sprint: define the queue first, generate master stills first, select winners, then spend video/motion credits only on winners.
lockedDecisions.scaleVisualRule: Invest heavily once in an exceptional design system, then componentize and reuse it; premium quality becomes valuable only if it can be productized.

flagships.name: Premium Plumbing / Installations
flagships.role: Primary sales demo and first production system
flagships.brief: Urgency hook, premium allround positioning, one consistent technician, high-end white/red visual world, real project-proof slots and a complete problem-to-relief story.

flagships.name: Luxury Renovation / Contractor
flagships.role: Best environment for before/after and Apple-like scroll storytelling
flagships.brief: Architectural imagery, material detail, room transformations, construction process and premium craftsmanship.

flagships.name: Beauty / Aesthetics
flagships.role: Show the system can become editorial, luxurious and appointment-led
flagships.brief: Skin/glass/liquid macro imagery, refined motion, premium treatment cards and booking-first conversion.

flagships.name: Personal Brand / Coach
flagships.role: Show a human/authority-led system rather than another service-company clone
flagships.brief: Face-led storytelling, authority, transformation narrative, video and a distinct personal brand world.

Define what must be custom versus what can be standardized without feeling templated.

Write the cold-call/outreach system only after offer + proof demo are strong enough to support it.
Create the four flagship briefs and page/section maps.
Create a model/capability matrix for each asset type before the Higgsfield sprint.
Estimate credit budget by stills, variants, elements and motion tests before subscription spend.

ideaBank: Apple-level scroll storytelling applied to ordinary local service businesses.
Premium tech-brand treatment for trades: a local installer presented with the care normally reserved for automotive/consumer-tech brands.
VOZOL-like sense of visual effort and product presentation, simplified enough to keep trust and conversion high.
White + deep red as a signature system, using marble/stone/chrome/glass/water for premium materiality.
Opening plumbing sequence: premium bathroom leak → phone → vehicle arrival → technician at work → clean resolution → 'wil jij ook zo geholpen worden?' CTA.
Interactive before/after transformations for renovation and future prospect demos.
One master demo technician as a reusable reference element across stills and motion.
Prospect-specific hero variants generated from locked master compositions rather than redesigning from zero.
Real project photos placed inside ultra-premium proof frames so nuchter businesses still feel authentic.
A literal 'visual drawer': industry → hero / people / environments / textures / services / animations / transitions / cases / CTA / mockups / rejected.
Store every winning asset with model, prompt, aspect ratio, usage, rating, motion-ready and customizable metadata.
Create reusable sales mockups so calls can instantly show 'this could be yours' rather than explaining design abstractly.
Province-by-province scaling only after first-customer unit economics and conversion are proven.
productionRules: One coherent website world beats a folder full of unrelated pretty generations.
Start with master stills. Do not spend motion/video credits until a still/composition is approved.
Create or lock the recurring technician first, then build scenes around that identity.
Generate for exact website slots/aspect ratios whenever possible rather than creating generic art and hoping it fits later.
Keep real proof real: actual projects, reviews and real-team claims need actual source material.
Separate premium shell from operator identity so the system works for polished companies and nuchter family businesses alike.
Keep rejected experiments because they can become alternatives later, but never let them pollute the approved asset set.
Batch only after a direction is locked; broad reruns before selection waste credits and reduce consistency.
higgsfieldPlan: Pre-plan the complete generation queue before subscription activation.
Create the plumbing master technician as a reusable reference element if the selected Higgsfield model/workflow supports it reliably.
Generate several candidate master stills for each critical website slot, not random scenes.
Select the small set of winners for hero/story/technical/detail/CTA.
Animate only winners and only when motion materially improves the website experience.
Archive prompt + model + reference + ratio + result for every approved asset so the system can be reused after the subscription ends.
Use future custom generations only where a paying client genuinely needs client-specific identity or imagery.
